title: Languages & scripts
about: Shop signs and street names give away the country. The quiz shows real-style street signage. Learn the unique letters first, then the giveaway words.

groups.iberian: Spanish / Portuguese (Spain vs Latin America, Portugal vs Brazil)

items.vs: LatAm uses carro/auto, estacionamiento, computadora, celular, jugo, boleto

items.words: estacionamiento, celular, computadora, jugo, boleto, renta, llantera, abarrotes, colectivo (AR), camión (MX bus), ustedes
items.vs: Spain uses aparcamiento, móvil, ordenador, zumo, billete, alquiler

items.vs: Brazil: ônibus, trem, celular, café da manhã, banheiro, açougue, pedágio, prefeitura (also ô vs ó: Brazil 'ônibus', Portugal 'económico')

items.uniq: é è ê ë ç œ à

items.uniq: å ä ö

items.uniq: æ ø å

items.uniq: æ ø å
items.words: og, udgang, indgang, åbent, lukket, gade, ikke, af
items.vs: Norwegian: utgang, inngang, åpent, stengt, gate

items.words: katu, tie, kauppa, avoinna, suljettu, -katu, -tie

items.words: улица, магазин, продукты, аптека, выход, вход

items.uniq: ѓ ќ ѕ ј љ њ
items.words: улица, излез, влез, продавница
